items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Van T. Houston; the name is mentioned only by the interviewer in the context of a newspaper photo.

ctx.x: I think they all know what, brother. Did you belong to any of the, uh, organizations? Fireman's, fireman's or so on?
The farmers club? This is one of the, uh, air prowls. Look at that young, young. Oh, that's Van T. Houston. The clarion?
Yeah, the clarion here. We've got a write-up on Beth Houston in the clarion, Harold, July 12th, 1973. You might want to look that up. The picture on the front page.
